datasets.name: PersonTypes
datasets.sql:
select 
  ID,
  DESCRIPION
from
  CM_PERSONS

order by id

datasets.name: Main
datasets.sql:
select p.newfinanceamount,p.creditlineamount, p.numberofcredit,p.annualyinterestrate,P.dateofconclusion,P.duedatefirstcontract,h.rest,h.interestrest,h.duerest,h.dueinterestrest,
 CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(a.LOANACCID)    as Ssuda,
 CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(a.INTERESTACCID)as faizhes,
 CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(a.DUELOANACCID)  as GecSsuda, u.DESCRIPTION,
 CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(a.DUEINTERESTACCID)as Gecfaizhes, ca.description as "Müştərinin tipi",
 cm_common.get_accname(a.CONTRACTACCID)  as name,h.pledgeprice /*ip.PREDCOST*/ as "Ipoteka pridmentinin dəyəri"
 from
 creditsmgr.cm_active_credits p/*,cm_ip_info ip*/,creditsmgr.cm_categories ca,
 creditsmgr.cm_history h,creditsmgr.cm_accounts a,creditsmgr.CM_USERGROUPS u
 where
 p.id=h.creditid and /*ip.creditid=p.id and*/ ca.id=p.customertype and
 h.hdate=:dat /*and h.rest+h.INTERESTREST>0*/ and
 p.id=a.creditid and u.id=p.usrgroup
